name: Niké je tipovanie
verdict: Slovak sports-betting brand of NIKÉ, spol. s r.o., a private company owned by three individuals. Nothing found.
aliases: Niké liga (title sponsor of the Slovak First Football League)
note: Not related to Nike, Inc. (separate sponsor record 'nike'). Title sponsor of the Niké liga since 2023/24 and general partner of ŠK Slovan Bratislava (club website partner list). Owner checked via the Slovak commercial register: three private individuals, no state or state-fund stake. Gambling sponsor — owner chain checked per METHOD.md; no state links found.
